subject: Evidence-lite renewal + seat-tier swap request
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Grant <taylor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence-lite renewal + seat-tier swap request

Hi Taylor —

Following our QBR, Acme is ready to renew but prefers a slimmer evidence bundle this cycle (they want to avoid a full intake). Two asks from their procurement side:

1) Allow a condensed evidence delivery (SOC2 link + last 30-day audit log extract) instead of the standard intake checklist.
2) Apply a seat-tier swap: move 150 seats from Standard to Enterprise seat credits for the first 6 months of the new term, then revert to the committed mix.

I've attached a short renewal summary and a proposed seat_swap_matrix for clarity. Can procurement confirm whether Acme can do:
- Single PO with two line items (term license + temporary enterprise seat uplift) OR
- Two POs (renewal + short-term seat uplift)?

High level timeline we need to hit:
- PO issued: by 2026-12-20
- Effective term start: 2027-01-01
- Seat uplift effective: 2027-01-01 to 2027-06-30

If you need anything else to avoid a full vendor intake, let us know and we can route SOC2 and the 30-day logs directly to your security mailbox.

Thanks —

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
Attachment: renewal_summary_v2.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
From: Taylor Grant <taylor@acmehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence-lite renewal + seat-tier swap request

Thanks Lauren — quick clarifying questions from procurement: 

- We can accept a condensed evidence bundle, but legal needs the SOC2 attestation and a short statement that logs are retained for 30 days and will be delivered on request. Could you point me to a hosted SOC2 PDF and confirm retention policy in one sentence?
- For the seat-tier swap: procurement prefers a single PO with two line items. Is Redwood able to split invoicing that way? We need unit prices for both lines and a SKU for the temporary uplift.

Also, do you have a DocuSign-ready amendment or should I prepare the PO and route to your billing contact?

—Taylor
Taylor Grant
Senior Procurement Specialist, Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence-lite renewal + seat-tier swap request

Lauren — looping in the numbers and evidence ownership.

SOC2 link: https://drive.redwood.com/Acme/attestations/SOC2-2026-report.pdf (public link for procurement/attorneys).
Retention statement (one-liner you can paste): "Redwood Inference retains system logs for 30 days and will provide extracts for authorized requests within 5 business days."

Invoicing/PO notes:
- We can accept a single PO with two line items. 
- Proposed line items (suggested SKUs):
  - RINF-ANNUAL-TERM: Annual license (committed seats) — Unit price: $12.00 / seat / month
  - RINF-TEMP-UPLIFT: Temporary Enterprise credits (6-month uplift) — Unit price: $22.50 / seat / month
- We'll accept a single PO referencing ACME-RENEW-2026-78 and will issue two invoices if Acme prefers split billing (one upfront for license, one monthly for uplift).

Attached is a seat_swap_matrix.xlsx that maps the seat move and invoice examples. I recommend offering the single PO with two lines to keep procurement workflow simple.

If legal needs an amendment, we can push a DocuSign envelope; otherwise supply the PO and we will counter-sign.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: seat_swap_matrix.xlsx (mapping & sample invoice rows)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Grant <taylor@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 16:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence-lite renewal + seat-tier swap request

Taylor — thanks, that's perfect. Summary and next steps below so procurement has a single place to act: 

Action items for Acme procurement (requested):
- Create a single PO referencing ACME-RENEW-2026-78 with two line items: RINF-ANNUAL-TERM and RINF-TEMP-UPLIFT (see attached seat_swap_matrix.xlsx for quantities and unit pricing).
- In the PO comments include: "Evidence-lite: SOC2 link + 30-day log extract; logs delivered on request."
- Route PO to billing@redwood.com (we will accept split invoices if needed).

If you'd like, I can send an amendment via DocuSign that lists the short-term seat uplift and term start; otherwise accept the PO and we'll countersign. DocuSign link (if useful): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCD1234

Attached: procure-instructions.md — a 1-page guide for your AP team to avoid delays.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line before 12/20.

Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: procure-instructions.md (1 page AP instructions)
From: Taylor Grant <taylor@acmehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Lauren — thanks for the clarity. Acme will:
- Issue a single PO today with the two line items requested.
- Billing contact: AP Team <ap@acmehealth.com> (please send final invoices to ap@acmehealth.com and include the PO number ACME-PO-99214 on all pages).

We will not require a DocuSign amendment; PO + SOC2 link + your retention statement is sufficient. I will reply with the issued PO PDF once it's attached to our system.

—Taylor
